review: The release of bootleg Knight of Despair Rodion into the current pool of Rodion IDs is certainly a design choice and definitely does not make her the coughing baby in comparison to the hydrogen bomb that is the other Rodion IDs! Haute Couture::Alteration Shop Rodion is a Charge-based identity with Tremor sprinkled into it. Haute Couture Rodion hyper-specializes in supporting allies that have base skills that apply, gain, or consume Charge or Unique Charge by giving them buffs such as Shield, Offense Level Up, and Attack Power Up (she can support normal identities, but the effects are extremely diminished, so it's better to use Princess Rodion).
